al-native-nongame.title: Ala. Admin. Code r. 220-2-.92
al-native-nongame.note: Alabama Legislature's administrative code rule listing nongame wildlife species that cannot be taken, possessed, or sold without a permit.

az-license-take.title: Ariz. Admin. Code R12-4-406, R12-4-407
az-license-take.note: Arizona Game and Fish Commission's live wildlife rules, hosted by AZGFD, R12-4-406 sets the restricted wildlife special license requirement and R12-4-407 lists exemptions from it.

ca-5-60.title: Cal. Code Regs. tit. 14, § 5.60
ca-5-60.note: CDFW's current Freshwater Sport Fishing Regulations booklet, which reprints Title 14 section 5.60 in full, including species bag limits and county closures.

co-unregulated-wildlife.title: 2 CCR 406-11, Ch. 0 (Unregulated Wildlife)
co-unregulated-wildlife.note: Colorado Secretary of State's current codified text of CPW's Chapter W-11 rule, whose Chapter 0 general provisions define the unregulated wildlife and prohibited species lists.

ct-26-55-6.title: Regs. Conn. State Agencies § 26-55-6
ct-26-55-6.note: Connecticut's official eRegulations portal text sorting wild animals into four possession categories by danger level.

de-native-wildlife.title: Del. Code tit. 7, c. 7
de-native-wildlife.note: Delaware Code Online's game and fish possession chapter administered by DNREC, paired with a separate exotic species permit chapter at Del. Code tit. 3, c. 72.

ma-321cmr9-01.title: 321 CMR 9.01
ma-321cmr9-01.note: MassWildlife's official exemption list under M.G.L. c. 131, section 23, only species actually named in it may be imported, sold, or possessed without a license.

md-native-herp.title: COMAR 08.03.11 (formerly cited as 08.03.09, adopted 1993)
md-native-herp.note: Maryland's native reptile and amphibian possession permit chapter, permanently adopted December 1, 1993, and renumbered from 08.03.09 to 08.03.11 since then.

ne-captive-wildlife.title: 163 Neb. Admin. Code ch. 4, § 008
ne-captive-wildlife.note: Nebraska Game and Parks Commission's own wildlife regulations booklet, section 008 lists which species require a Captive Wildlife Permit.

nj-7-25-4-8.title: N.J.A.C. 7:25-4.8(a)
nj-7-25-4-8.note: NJDEP Fish and Wildlife's courtesy copy of its potentially dangerous species table, ordinary colubrid snakes such as kingsnakes and garter snakes are not on it.

nv-unprotected-reptiles.title: NAC 503.090
nv-unprotected-reptiles.note: Nevada Legislature's administrative code chapter defining unprotected reptiles as any species not classified protected, sensitive, threatened, or endangered.

or-635-056-0060.title: OAR 635-056-0060
or-635-056-0060.note: Oregon Secretary of State's administrative rules database entry listing wildlife species exempt from ODFW importation permits.

pa-58-79.title: 58 Pa. Code Ch. 79
pa-58-79.note: Official Pennsylvania Code and Bulletin chapter, Fish and Boat Commission rules that apply only to species native to Pennsylvania and only to wild take, which requires a fishing license.

ut-r657-53.title: Utah Admin. Code R657-53-5
ut-r657-53.note: Utah DWR's own hosting of rule R657-53, section 5 lists activities allowed without a wildlife document, including noncontrolled species possession thresholds.

vt-10-app-18.title: 10 V.S.A. App. § 18
vt-10-app-18.note: Vermont Legislature's official text requiring an Importation and Possession Permit for any wild animal not on the Commissioner's Unrestricted Wild Animals List.

wi-nr16-12.title: Wis. Admin. Code NR 16.12-16.15
wi-nr16-12.note: Wisconsin Legislature's codified DNR chapter on captive wildlife, sections 16.12 through 16.15 set possession and take limits for native reptiles and amphibians.

wi-import-permit.title: Wis. Stat. § 169.04
wi-import-permit.note: Wisconsin Legislature's captive wildlife statute requiring lawful acquisition, animals sourced from out of state also need a DATCP import permit.
